dedupe_keys.name: time series of hourly resolution solar pv generation for indian scale energy system studies

description: Time Series of Hourly Resolution Solar PV Generation for Indian-Scale Energy System Studies is a data set deposited in DTU Data by its authors Polyneikis Kanellas, Matti Juhani Koivisto (Technical University of Denmark). This dataset provides Pan-Indian simulated hourly time series of solar PV generation designed to support large-scale energy system modeling and analysis. In total, the dataset consists of three different technologies (rooftop PV, utility-scale PV with tracking, and utility-scale PV without tracking), each simulated across three resource grades (RGA, RGB, and RGC). Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1447711515 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
